intro: Pakistan is a federal parliamentary republic and an Islamic republic, where the army has long held great influence.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister leads the government and is chosen by the National Assembly. The president is head of state. There are four provinces, Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, plus the capital territory.
Pakistan-administered Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan have their own special arrangements.

chapters.title: The army and politics
text: The army has ruled directly several times, most recently under General Pervez Musharraf from 1999 to 2008. Even under elected governments it remains very powerful, and no prime minister has yet completed a full five-year term.

keyTerms.meaning: A system where power is shared between national and regional governments.
